focus.title: 欧盟拟对华电动汽车加征反补贴关税，中企供应链需提前布局
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于7月30日公布拟对中国产电动汽车加征17%至36%反补贴关税的初步裁定，涉及比亚迪、上汽等多家车企及电池供应商。该措施若通过，将于11月正式实施。建议出口企业立即启动原产地规则审查、调整欧洲本地化生产比例，并考虑通过第三国转口或与欧盟车企合资等合规路径降低关税影响。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会官方公报 · 2026.07.31
focus.title_en: EU Plans Anti-Subsidy Tariffs on Chinese EVs, Supply Chain Adjustments Urgent
focus.summary_en: On July 30, the European Commission announced preliminary anti-subsidy tariffs of 17% to 36% on Chinese EVs, targeting BYD, SAIC, and battery suppliers. If adopted, the measures will take effect in November. Exporters should immediately review rules of origin, increase local production in Europe, and explore third-country transshipment or joint ventures with EU automakers to mitigate tariff risks.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：跨境数据合规条款缺失导致企业赔偿200万美元
case.summary: 在SIAC仲裁案ARB-2025-089中，中国某跨境电商平台因未在服务协议中明确约定数据跨境传输的合规标准，被新加坡合作方索赔。仲裁庭认定平台违反GDPR第44条，判令赔偿200万美元并承担仲裁费用。此案警示：涉欧数据业务必须嵌入GDPR合规条款，明确数据控制者与处理者责任。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心案件摘要 · 2026.07
case.title_en: SIAC Award: Missing Cross-Border Data Compliance Clause Costs Chinese E-Commerce Firm USD 2 Million
case.summary_en: In SIAC case ARB-2025-089, a Chinese cross-border e-commerce platform was ordered to pay USD 2 million in damages and arbitration costs for failing to include data transfer compliance standards in its service agreement, violating GDPR Article 44. The case highlights the necessity of embedding GDPR clauses and defining controller/processor responsibilities in EU-related data contracts.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”试点扩至深圳前海，企业备案即可传输
policy.summary: 广东省网信办7月30日发布通知，将大湾区数据跨境流动“白名单”试点从珠海横琴扩展至深圳前海。符合条件的金融、医疗、物流企业可通过备案制实现日常经营数据向港澳自由传输，无需逐笔审批。该政策大幅降低合规成本，但企业仍需建立内部数据分类分级制度。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.07.30
policy.title_en: GBA Cross-Border Data Flow 'White List' Pilot Expanded to Qianhai, Shenzhen – Filing-Based Transfer Now Available
policy.summary_en: On July 30, the Guangdong Cyberspace Administration expanded the GBA cross-border data flow 'white list' pilot from Hengqin, Zhuhai to Qianhai, Shenzhen. Qualified financial, healthcare, and logistics companies can now freely transfer routine operational data to Hong Kong and Macau via a filing system, eliminating case-by-case approval. This policy significantly reduces compliance costs, though firms must still establish internal data classification systems.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华半导体设备管制升级，中企应启动“合规审计+供应链备份”双预案
analysis.summary: 美国商务部工业安全局（BIS）近期拟修订《出口管理条例》，扩大对华半导体制造设备的最终用户管控范围。秦林蒿律师研判：此举将导致更多中国晶圆厂面临设备供应中断风险。建议相关企业立即开展内部合规审计，梳理受管制物项清单；同时加速国产设备验证与替代供应商开发，并考虑通过海外子公司申请许可证。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: US Semiconductor Equipment Controls Tightened – Chinese Firms Should Launch 'Compliance Audit + Supply Chain Backup'
analysis.summary_en: The US BIS is proposing to expand end-user controls on semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China. Attorney Qin advises: this will increase supply disruption risks for Chinese fabs. Companies should promptly conduct internal compliance audits to identify controlled items, accelerate domestic equipment qualification and alternative supplier development, and consider applying for licenses through overseas subsidiaries.
